$comment: Canonical registry of every README-driven landing page at mindattic.com/<slug>.htm. Edit ONLY this file to add, remove, or retag a project. Build = node src/build.js. Deploy = node src/deploy.js. componentsVersion pins the jsDelivr tag for MindAttic.UIUX (Components and Themes both come from this ref); use 'main' for tip-of-tree, or 'v1.0.0' style tags for immutable cache hits in production. Each project picks a theme via the 'theme' field; valid values match folder names under MindAttic.UIUX/Themes/ (currently: Cyberspace, Hardware).
